div.div: غُبْطَةٌ A strap in the [leathern water-bag called] مَزَادَة, (Ibn-'Abbád, O, K,) like the شِرَاك [of the sandal], (Ibn-'Abbád, O,) which is put upon the extremities of the two skins [whereof the مزادة is mainly composed] and then strongly sewed. (Ibn- 'Abbád, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
